text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Totally enchanted by Hishi Akebono's 
racing,
Taiki Shuttle boldly lays down the 
gauntlet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing this, even Hishi Akebono grew 
nervous— or not,
as she headed to the race 
with her usual reassuring smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With expectations soaring for the clash
of 
the titans,
the curtain rose on the Yasuda 
Kinen!
